units.source_text: 薰君设想：她自己也是处女，怎么能够像长辈那样处理妹妹的婚事呢？

en.t: Kaoru thought: she herself was still unmarried, so how could she handle her younger sister's marriage as though she were an elder guardian?

units.source_text: 她的不能答复原是理之当然。

en.t: It was only natural that she could give no answer.

units.source_text: 便召唤那老侍女弁君出来，和她商谈。

en.t: He therefore called out the old gentlewoman Ben no Kimi and consulted with her.

units.source_text: 对她说道：“多年以来，我只是为了欲修后世而到这里来请教的。

en.t: He said to her, "For many years I came here only to seek guidance in preparing for the life to come.

units.source_text: 但亲王将近逝世之时，自觉寿命有限，曾将两女公子托付与我，叫我任意处置，我曾当面允诺。

en.t: But when the Prince was near death and knew his life was ending, he entrusted his two daughters to me and told me to act as I thought best, and I promised him face to face.

units.source_text: 不料两女公子的意见与亲王的主张完全相左，对我态度非常强硬，不知由于何故？

en.t: Unexpectedly, the two ladies' wishes are completely opposed to the Prince's intention, and their attitude toward me is very firm; I do not know why.

units.source_text: 竟使我疑心她们另有打算呢。

en.t: It has even made me suspect that they have some other plan in mind.

units.source_text: 你当然也听到过：我的本性非常怪异，对世俗男女之事全不关心。

en.t: You must have heard that my nature is very strange, and that I have no interest at all in worldly affairs between men and women.

units.source_text: 然而恐是前世注定之故，我对大小姐如此热心爱慕。

en.t: Yet perhaps because it was destined from a former life, I love the elder lady with such earnest devotion.

units.source_text: 外间也渐渐有人纷纷传说。

en.t: People outside have gradually begun to talk about it as well.

units.source_text: 所以我想：既然如此，还不如依照亲王的遗志，让我和大小姐像世间普通夫妇一般开诚相见。

en.t: So I thought that, since things have come to this, it would be better to follow the Prince's last wish and allow the elder lady and me to meet honestly, like an ordinary husband and wife in the world.

units.source_text: 此言虽属奢望，但世间岂无其例？”

en.t: This may be an extravagant hope, but surely there are examples of such a thing in the world?"

units.source_text: 接着又说：“匂亲王与二小姐之事，我也曾提出过。

en.t: He went on, "I have also raised the matter of Prince Niou and the younger lady.

units.source_text: 但大小姐不信任我，似乎有所顾虑。

en.t: But the elder lady does not trust me and seems to have some concern.

units.source_text: 这又不知何故？”

en.t: I do not know the reason for that either."

units.source_text: 他说时愁容满面。

en.t: As he spoke, his face was full of sorrow.

units.source_text: 倘是一般无知无识的侍女，此时一定随声附和，多嘴饶舌，说些讨好的话。

en.t: If she had been an ordinary ignorant gentlewoman, she would surely have chimed in at once, chattering on and saying things merely to please him.

units.source_text: 但弁君不是这种人，她心中想道：“倒真是两对好夫妻……”但嘴上答道：“恐怕这两位小姐生性怪僻，与常人不同，故关于世俗婚嫁之事，似乎绝不想起。

en.t: But Ben no Kimi was not that sort of person. In her heart she thought, "They really would make two fine couples," but aloud she answered, "I fear the two young ladies are eccentric by nature and unlike other people, so they seem never to think of worldly marriage at all.

units.source_text: 我们在这里当侍女的人，即使亲王在世的当年，谁也不曾蒙受荫庇。

en.t: Those of us who serve here as gentlewomen received no protection from anyone, even in the years when the Prince was alive.

units.source_text: 凡是重视自己前程的人，都找些适当借口，纷纷散去。

en.t: Anyone who cared about her own future found a suitable excuse and left one after another.

units.source_text: 那些自昔就有旧交的人，也都觉得在这里毫无希望。

en.t: Even those with old ties from the past felt there was no hope here.

units.source_text: 何况现在亲王已不在世，她们一刻也不能再留，都在那里发牢骚了。

en.t: Now that the Prince is no longer alive, they say they cannot stay even a moment longer, and they are all complaining about it.

units.source_text: 有的人说：‘亲王在世之时，由于门第高贵之故，凡是不甚体面的亲事，都被认为委屈。

en.t: Some say, 'When the Prince was alive, because of their noble birth, any marriage that was not quite respectable was considered beneath them.

units.source_text: 因有这种古风的思想，故两位小姐的亲事一直拖延不决。

en.t: Because of such old-fashioned thinking, the marriages of the two young ladies have been delayed and left unsettled all this time.

units.source_text: 现在她们已经失去依靠，应该变通办法，随缘成事。

en.t: Now that they have lost their support, they should adapt to circumstances and let a suitable bond come to pass.

units.source_text: 倘有强行讥议的人，其人反而不明事理，大可置之不理。

en.t: If anyone insists on criticizing them, that person is the one who does not understand reason, and may simply be ignored.

units.source_text: 无论怎样的人，总不能如此孤寂地度送一生吧。

en.t: No matter what kind of person one is, surely one cannot pass an entire life in such loneliness.

units.source_text: 即使是只吃松叶的苦行头陀，也舍不得生命，总想活在世上，所以在佛教中各树一种宗派而修行。’

en.t: Even ascetics who eat only pine needles still cling to life and wish to live in the world, which is why in Buddhism each establishes a sect and practices within it.'

units.source_text: 她们说这种用意不良的话，常常使得这两位年轻的小姐心烦意乱。

en.t: By saying such ill-intentioned things, they often upset the two young ladies.

units.source_text: 然而她们不屈不挠。

en.t: Yet the two ladies remain unyielding.

units.source_text: 大小姐只是关念二小姐之事，希望她能随俗事人。

en.t: The elder lady is concerned only for the younger lady and hopes she can follow worldly ways and serve a husband.

units.source_text: 您不惮深山远道，常来访问，多年以来小姐们已经见惯，认为您是可亲之人，现在又常将种种大小事务同您商量。

en.t: You have not shrunk from the remote mountains or the long road and have often come to visit; over the years the young ladies have grown used to you, regard you as someone close, and now often consult you about all sorts of matters great and small.

units.source_text: 如果您有意和二小姐成亲，对大小姐说了她一定答应。

en.t: If you intend to marry the younger lady, the elder lady will surely agree if you tell her.

units.source_text: 匂亲王常有信来，但她们似乎认为此人并无诚意。”

en.t: Prince Niou often sends letters, but they seem to think he has no sincerity."

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“我曾受亲王那句可哀的遗言嘱托，故在我这朝露一般短促的生命尚存的期间，一定常来亲近。

en.t: Kaoru replied, "I received the Prince's sorrowful dying request, so as long as this brief life of mine, like morning dew, remains, I will certainly continue to visit closely.

units.source_text: 按理说，叫我同任何一位小姐结缘，都是一样的。

en.t: In principle, it should be the same whichever of the two young ladies I form a bond with.

units.source_text: 蒙大小姐如此关心，我实不胜欣幸。

en.t: I am truly more grateful than I can say that the elder lady shows such concern for me.

units.source_text: 然而我虽已看破红尘，情之所钟，还是恋恋不舍。

en.t: Yet although I have seen through the vanity of the world, where my heart has fixed itself I still cannot let go.

units.source_text: 要我改变初心，另恋一人，实在不能。

en.t: To change my first intention and love someone else is truly impossible for me.

units.source_text: 我对大小姐的深情，决非世间寻常浮薄恋爱可比。

en.t: My deep feeling for the elder lady cannot possibly be compared with the ordinary shallow loves of the world.

units.source_text: 我所希望的，只是隔着帘帷相向而坐，毫无隔阂地罄谈人世无常之理，大小姐也毫无顾虑地向我陈述心事。

en.t: What I hope for is only to sit facing her across the curtains, speak without reserve about the impermanence of human life, and have the elder lady also tell me her thoughts without hesitation.

units.source_text: 我没有特别亲睦的弟兄，实在非常寂寞。

en.t: I have no brothers with whom I am especially close, and I am truly very lonely.

units.source_text: 在这世间每有所感，无论是可哀的、可喜的，或可忧的，凡是触景生情，都只能藏在自己心中，沉闷度日。

en.t: Whenever I feel anything in this world, whether sorrowful, joyful, or troubling, any emotion stirred by a scene must be hidden in my own heart as I pass my days in gloom.

units.source_text: 这生涯毕竟孤苦伶仃，故愿得大小姐开诚相怜。

en.t: Such a life is lonely and desolate after all, so I wish the elder lady would open her heart and show me compassion.

units.source_text: 明石皇后是我姐姐，然而未便过分亲近，将琐屑无聊之事任意向她说述。

en.t: The Akashi Empress is my elder sister, but it would not be proper to become too intimate with her or freely speak to her of trivial, foolish matters.

units.source_text: 三条院的公主虽然年纪轻得不像是我的母亲，毕竟地位不同，亦未便轻易和她亲近。

en.t: Although the princess of Sanjo-in is so young she hardly seems like my mother, her position is different after all, and it would not be proper to approach her casually either.

units.source_text: 至于其他女子，我都觉得疏远陌生，不敢接近。

en.t: As for other women, they all feel distant and unfamiliar to me, and I do not dare approach them.

units.source_text: 因有此种心情，所以我的生涯异常孤寂。

en.t: Because I feel this way, my life is extraordinarily lonely.

units.source_text: 谈情求爱之事，即使逢场作戏，我也非常嫌恶，绝不肯为。

en.t: As for talking of love and seeking affection, even as a passing game, I loathe it greatly and would never do it.

units.source_text: 生性如此孤僻，不解风流，故对大小姐真心爱慕之情，也难于出口。

en.t: Being by nature so withdrawn and so ignorant of romance, I find it hard even to speak of my sincere love for the elder lady.

units.source_text: 我心中又是怨恨，又是焦灼，然而连一点渴慕之色也不曾向大小姐表示过，自己想想也觉得太冥顽了。

en.t: In my heart I feel both resentment and burning impatience, yet I have never shown the elder lady even the slightest sign of longing, and when I think of it myself, I feel I have been terribly stubborn and foolish.

units.source_text: 至于匂亲王与二小姐之事，务请勿以我为存心不良，准许我的请求，如何？”

en.t: As for Prince Niou and the younger lady, please do not think I harbor any ill intention, but grant my request. What do you say?"

units.source_text: 老侍女听了这番话，心念此间生涯如此冷落，两位小姐能嫁这两个人，真乃求之不得。

en.t: When the old gentlewoman heard these words, she thought that life here was so bleak that if the two young ladies could marry these two men, nothing could be more desirable.

units.source_text: 她一心希望玉成其事，然而两位小姐态度之严肃，叫人看了自惭，因此未能任意向她们劝说。

en.t: She wholeheartedly wished to bring the matter about, but the two young ladies' bearing was so solemn that anyone who saw them felt ashamed, and so she could not freely urge them.

units.source_text: 薰君今宵准备在此留宿，和女公子从容谈话，就故意逡巡徘徊，直到日暮。

en.t: Kaoru planned to spend the night there and speak at leisure with the young lady, so he deliberately lingered and wandered about until dusk.
